step800.discrepancy_explanation: UCIP-26 reported mean_of_sequence_perplexities (e.g. 579.75 and 270.56) where each sequence's perplexity exp(NLL_i) is averaged across sequences. Jensen's inequality (E[exp(X)] >= exp(E[X])) inflates the mean when NLL variance is high. The mathematically principled micro perplexity exp(micro_nll) is lower and reflects true cross-token predictive cost.
